name: The Kathorran Delegation
description: The Tor-Kathorr contingent at the Forum, feuding with Silkmeadow over water and security.

relations.note: The delegations hate each other and have lodged complaints for three years.
relations.quote: And hate each other the Silkmeadow and Tor-Kathorr delegations did.
